title: Adult with severe unilateral headache
goal: You are the clinician. Assess a patient with a severe unilateral headache: cover onset, quality, associated symptoms, history, and red flags.
opening: I have this pounding headache on one side and it is making me sick to my stomach.

disclosures.response: It is on the right side, around my temple and behind my eye. It throbs.
It started this morning and has been building all day, maybe eight hours now.
It throbs and pounds, and it gets worse when I move around or bend over.
About twenty minutes before it got bad, I saw wavy lines and lights bothered me.
I feel nauseous and I threw up once about an hour ago.
Light and noise make it much worse. I have been lying in a dark room.
I have had headaches like this a few times a year since college. My mother gets migraines too, and ibuprofen usually helps.

metrics.name: Introduction and consent
metrics.rationale: Introduces self and establishes permission or rapport.
metrics.coaching_hint: Introduce yourself and ask permission before proceeding.

metrics.name: Symptom characterization
metrics.rationale: Explores onset, location, quality, and severity of the headache.
metrics.coaching_hint: Characterize the headache: 'Where is it, and when did it start?'

metrics.name: Associated symptoms
metrics.rationale: Checks for aura, nausea, vomiting, and photo/phonophobia.
metrics.coaching_hint: Ask about associated symptoms: 'Any aura, nausea, or sensitivity to light and sound?'

metrics.name: Headache history and triggers
metrics.rationale: Explores prior headache history, triggers, medications, and family history.
metrics.coaching_hint: Ask about history: 'Have you had headaches like this before, and do you take anything for them?'

metrics.name: Red-flag assessment
metrics.rationale: Screens for red flags such as thunderclap onset, fever, stiff neck, or focal deficit.
metrics.coaching_hint: Screen red flags: 'Is this your worst headache ever, with any fever, stiff neck, or weakness?'

metrics.name: Shared next-step confirmation
metrics.rationale: Checks understanding and confirms the immediate next step.
metrics.coaching_hint: Confirm the plan and check understanding before ending.
